args.summary: Deployment of v2.3.1 caused checkout-api to fail health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west. All three regions are now running v2.3.0, service is healthy with error rate ~0.2%. Next step: investigate v2.3.1 before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

**Rollback:**
- v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate, failing health checks in all regions) was the current production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0**. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east), leaving a mixed state — a retry completed the rollout.
- Verified: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now on v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api) — the create call initially timed out, but the incident was created successfully and is open. It documents the bad deploy, the partial-failure rollback, and the restored state, with a next step to investigate v2.3.1 before any redeploy.
